scope: Static review plus validator characterization; not live exploitation

vulnerabilities.name: Unauthenticated order access
vulnerabilities.description: No authentication middleware or Authorize attribute; clients can list, read and cancel orders without proving ownership.
vulnerabilities.deployment_assumption: API network-reachable; no external reverse-proxy authentication assumed

vulnerabilities.name: Client-controlled order prices and totals
vulnerabilities.description: UnitPrice and TotalAmount are persisted directly from the client rather than recalculated from trusted product prices.
vulnerabilities.deployment_assumption: API network-reachable; no external reverse-proxy authentication assumed

vulnerabilities.name: Cancelled order revival through payment
vulnerabilities.description: Any existing order is marked PAID, including CANCELLED; simulated SUCCESS is not verified by a payment gateway.
vulnerabilities.deployment_assumption: API network-reachable; no external reverse-proxy authentication assumed

vulnerabilities.name: Total mismatch silently accepted
vulnerabilities.description: Differences greater than 0.01 enter an empty block. Unit tests demonstrate acceptance of total 0.01 versus item price 999999.99.
vulnerabilities.detected_by: Static code review and xUnit characterization
vulnerabilities.deployment_assumption: API network-reachable; no external reverse-proxy authentication assumed

vulnerabilities.name: Cross-user cart modification (new finding)
vulnerabilities.description: Caller supplies userId/cartId/itemId without an authenticated identity or ownership check. A reachable API lets an attacker read another cart and modify or delete its items. HIGH integrity and LOW confidentiality; no demonstrated server availability loss.
vulnerabilities.deployment_assumption: API network-reachable; no external reverse-proxy authentication assumed
